Uttar Pradesh plans India's first data corridor with ₹6 lakh crore investment

The Uttar Pradesh government has announced plans to establish India's first dedicated Data Corridor. The project is backed by an estimated investment of ₹6 lakh crore and aims to bolster the state's digital infrastructure. Boston Consulting Group (BCG) is reportedly preparing a roadmap for this initiative, which includes a 6 GW digital infrastructure network.
